markdown:
Hier ein paar Code snippets als Gedankenstütze zu dem, was möglich ist:

```Attribut_Liste
table date_outgame, date_ingame
where contains(tags, "Session") = true
```

```Tags_Liste
table aliases
where tags = "NPC"
```

```Gruppierte_Sortierte_Liste
TABLE 
	rows.file.link AS "Name"

WHERE contains(tags, "NPC") = true
WHERE contains(faction, "Order of Light") = true
SORT file.name ASC
GROUP BY rank AS "Rank"
SORT choice(Rank = "Headmaster", "1",
choice(Rank = "Magister", "2",
choice(Rank = "Scholar", "3",
choice(Rank = "Acolyte", "4",
choice(Rank = "Apprentice", "5",
choice(Rank = "Novice", "6",
"other"))))))

```
